dedupe_keys.name: curated multi domain energy and socio economic dataset for a 12 country entso e power system

description: Curated Multi-Domain Energy and Socio-Economic Dataset for a 12-Country ENTSO-E Power System is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ugochukwu Orji, Cicek Guven (Tilburg University). This curated dataset integrates publicly available, multi-domain data representing the energy systems and socio-economic context of 12 ENTSO-E countries. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
